wind.title: Cryfder y gwynt

the-wind-at-its-strongest-overnight.text: Y gwynt ar ei gryfaf dros nos
the-wind-at-its-strongest-overnight.note: {{ar ei}} means at its; the same pattern as {{ar ei uchaf}}

gusts-of-up-to-70-mph.text: Hyrddiadau hyd at 70 milltir yr awr

about-60-mph-on-the-coast.text: Rhyw 60 milltir yr awr ar yr arfordir

wind.order: lightest to strongest, then gusts and speeds

wind-direction.title: Cyfeiriad y gwynt
wind-direction.intro: Forecasters name a wind by the direction it blows from. A south-westerly comes from the south-west.

a-biting-easterly.note: {{main}} means thin; of a wind, keen or biting

wind-direction.order: round the compass from the north

warnings.title: Rhybuddion

the-met-office-has-issued-a-yellow-wind-.text: Mae'r Swyddfa Dywydd wedi cyhoeddi rhybudd melyn am wynt

the-warning-comes-into-force-at-six-this.text: Bydd y rhybudd yn dod i rym am chwech o'r gloch heno

in-force-until-three-in-the-morning.text: Mewn grym tan dri o'r gloch y bore

the-met-office-is-warning-of-rough-weath.text: Mae'r Swyddfa Dywydd yn rhybuddio am dywydd garw

warnings.order: issued, coming into force and in force, then the levels and the warning itself
